summary_en: Full-year net profit forecast raised to ¥2,500 million, prompting year-end dividend increase from ¥40 to ¥70 per share, bringing total annual dividend to ¥110 per share with 100% payout ratio.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Financial Forecast, Upward Revision, and Modification of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for Fiscal Year Ended March 31, 2027
translation_en_brief:
Tayca Corporation has raised its full-year consolidated net profit forecast for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2027, to ¥2,500 million from the previous forecast of ¥1,800 million, representing an increase of ¥700 million or 38.9%. In response to this improvement, the company has revised its year-end dividend forecast upward by ¥30 per share, from ¥40 to ¥70 per share. Combined with the interim dividend of ¥40 per share already paid, the total annual dividend is now projected at ¥110 per share, up from the previous forecast of ¥80 per share, resulting in a 100% payout ratio.

The upward earnings revision reflects stronger-than-expected demand in the second quarter, particularly in general-purpose titanium dioxide and surfactant products, as well as productivity improvements and cost reductions that offset raw material price increases. Second-quarter results substantially exceeded prior guidance across all profitability metrics, with operating profit of ¥3,199 million versus a forecast of ¥1,800 million. Management expects second-half performance to remain firm based on current order book conditions.

The dividend increase aligns with the company's stated policy of balancing mid-to-long-term stable profit distribution to shareholders with maintenance of adequate capital for future growth investments and operational strengthening. The company applies a dividend framework based on the higher of a Dividend on Equity (DOE) target of 3% or a 100% payout ratio, and has determined that the 100% payout ratio standard now applies given the improved earnings outlook.
